title: PP2 Graduation Ceremony 2026
excerpt: Our PP2 class celebrated their graduation today with songs, dances, and a special certificate ceremony.
body:
Our PP2 class celebrated their graduation today with songs, dances, and a special certificate ceremony. Each child received a certificate and a small gift from their teacher, Mr. Kamau. It was a proud moment for parents and teachers alike.

Congratulations to all our graduates! You are ready for Grade 1.

title: New Playground Equipment Installed
excerpt: We are excited to share that our new playground equipment is now ready for use!
body:
We are excited to share that our new playground equipment is now ready for use! The children have been enjoying the new swings, slide, and climbing frame during break time.

Thank you to all parents who contributed to this upgrade. Safe play is an important part of our approach to learning.

title: Term 1 Open Day — Saturday 15th February
excerpt: We welcome all prospective parents to our Term 1 Open Day this Saturday.
body:
We welcome all prospective parents to our Term 1 Open Day this Saturday. Tour the school, meet our teachers, and see our classrooms in action.

Time: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Location: Jomoko, near Kingdom Seekers Church, Thika

No appointment needed. Just walk in or call ahead.
